title: Heaps / Priority Queues
definition: A heap is a specialized tree-based structure satisfying the heap property (max or min).
intuition: Efficiently find and extract the maximum or minimum element.
how_it_works: Implemented as a binary tree mapped to an array. Rebalancing is done via sift-up/down.
when_to_use: For top-k problems, merging sorted arrays, or scheduling algorithms.
complexity: Get Min/Max: O(1), Insert/Extract: O(log n)
content: A heap is a specialized tree-based structure satisfying the heap property (max or min).
